report_discrepancies.note: Exhibit B (p2) prints Capital projects 11,436,387.39 and Other student support 503,561.10; Exhibit D (p6) prints 11,468,688.94 and 471,259.55. The 32,301.55 is classed in different functions; total disbursements 19,078,661.38 agree. JSON follows Exhibit D.

notes: Modified cash basis school district; all funds are governmental (School Nutrition and Activities are in the governmental funds), so business_type is null. Receipts/disbursements are from the Total Governmental Funds column (Exhibit D, spans pp5-6; labels p5, amounts p6), after the Reclassifications column which nets the 42,459.06 General-to-Other-funds transfer to zero, so transfers are null at top level. Beginning cash = beginning fund balance/net position 19,459,092.11 (p6); ending 8,983,358.03 ties to Exhibit A (p1). Identity reconciles. Re-check (attempt 2): 'Taxes: Property' 3,173,166.29 split into property tax 3,167,064.58 and penalties and interest 6,101.71 from the fund schedules (pp9, 16, 17); 'Taxes: Other' 1,925,010.92 split into Homestead Exemption 31,328.10, Property Tax Credit 1,880,717.66, Motor Vehicle Pro-Rate 10,359.20 and Carline Tax 2,605.96 from the fund schedules; 'Other local receipts' tuition part (1370 Preschool tuition 8,124.51) split out as Tuition Received; County receipts ESU part (2210) is ESU Receipts; balance sheet now the governmental funds Balance Sheet (Exhibit C, pp3-4, Total Governmental Funds column, fund balance by classification), whose totals equal the Statement of Net Position (p1); Exhibit N program lines follow the report's grouping (3535/3551/3599 State Categorical Programs and 6200/6408/6992/6998 Federal Programs, which sum to the statement's State programs 216,371.05 and Federal programs 202,242.96 lines); 2230 Instruction-related technology is support services; Printing & Publishing object is printing, publishing and postage. 'Other student support' 471,259.55 split into Activities (227,794.90, p14) and School Nutrition (243,464.65, p15) disbursements, which sum to it; 'Debt service' split into principal and interest+fees from Bond Fund schedule p16. Detail: General Fund receipts from budget schedule Exhibit G (pp9-10); General Fund spending uses Exhibit N object detail (pp18-24; its Total Cash Disbursements 6,709,256.67 on p24, incl. the 42,459.06 transfer, ties to the budget schedule total); Exhibit N prints no budgets, so budget_final is null; program totals match Exhibit G. Exhibit F (General Fund components, pp7-8) not recorded in detail to avoid double counting. Hidden transfers: Exhibit F reclassification column (p8) shows 309,691.00 of General Fund spending (133,091 regular instruction, 41,000 operation/maintenance, 135,600 regular transportation) is really the transfer to the Depreciation Fund (receipt on p12); recorded as contra lines plus an other financing item. The 8000 Transfers 42,459.06 is an other financing item; the receiving side is inside Activities Fund receipts (374,732.64 = 332,273.58 + 42,459.06 derived from Other Governmental Funds receipts 583,045.13 = 374,732.64 + 208,312.49), recorded as contra line plus other financing. Exhibit G regular instruction etc. differ from Exhibit F by 350 (3300 Community service shown inside Regular instruction on p7). Per-line budgets not printed for Exhibit N, Activities and fund schedules other than totals. Zero ('-') lines not recorded. Attempt 3 (verifier fixes 2026-10-28): statement 'Special education school age' 271,861.26 and 'Special education 0-5' 43,729.42 are printed under 'Support services - students' (p5) and are SPED related services in Exhibit N, so now support services (Pupils); Other Governmental Funds 'Other local receipts' 292,844.39 now Extracurricular Receipts (dominant, ~63% activity receipts, rest lunch sales; review); 'Sales - non-reimbursable' and the Activities contra line categories corrected to School Lunch Sales / Extracurricular Receipts.
